messages.campaign_fixture.quest.losses_catch_up.d: Learn the recorded loss from the witness and continue your personal story.
campaign_fixture.quest.losses_catch_up.o: Our mentor has been permanently lost. I can tell you what happened and help you continue.
campaign_fixture.quest.losses_catch_up.c: The mentor will not return to this role. This account records what you learned without claiming that you participated in the loss.
Your account completes this part of the story and earns 5 personal experience.
